curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs > /tmp/r.json; head -c 150 /tmp/r.json; echo; python3 -c "
import json,urllib.request
j=json.load(open(\"/tmp/r.json\"))
p=j[\"proposals\"][\"pending\"]
print(\"pending\",len(p))
for x in p[:3]:
    u=\"http://localhost:8091/api/prop_chart?run=%s&t_in=%s&side=%s\"%(x[\"run\"],x[\"t_in\"],x[\"side\"])
    try:
        d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=60))
        print(x[\"sym\"],x[\"tf\"],x.get(\"sig\"),\"ch\",bool(d.get(\"ch\")),\"struct\",bool(d.get(\"struct\")),d[\"lines\"],len(d[\"chart\"][\"t\"]))
    except Exception as e: print(x[\"sym\"],\"ERR\",e)
"
